giant-viper.name: Giant Viper
giant-viper.blurb: The giant viper's fangs are a frightening sight, with injection tubes as long as daggers. The sheer amount of venom injected by a giant viper can cause severe blood clotting and leave a victim utterly drained of vitality.

abilities.name: Coiled Strike (Special)
abilities.desc:
As Reactive Strike, but the snake can use this reaction only if it's Coiled.

Trigger A creature within the monster's reach uses a manipulate action or a move action, makes a ranged attack, or leaves a square during a move action it's using.

Effect The monster attempts a melee Strike against the triggering creature. If the attack is a critical hit and the trigger was a manipulate action, the monster disrupts that action. This Strike doesn't count toward the monster's multiple attack penalty, and its multiple attack penalty doesn't apply to this Strike.

abilities.name: Coil
abilities.desc: The giant viper uses an action to coil itself. While Coiled, the reach of its fangs is 10 feet and it has the Reactive Strike reaction. After the giant viper Strikes with its fangs, it becomes uncoiled.

abilities.name: Giant Viper Venom
abilities.desc:
Saving Throw DC 17 Fortitude save

Maximum Duration 6 rounds

Stage 1 1d6 poison damage (1 round)

Stage 2 1d6 poison damage and Drained 1

living-landslide.name: Living Landslide
living-landslide.blurb: Living landslides resemble humanoids made of earth and gravel. They find moving across the many surfaces of the mortal Universe strangely liberating.

abilities.name: Tremorsense (Imprecise) 60 feet
abilities.desc: Tremorsense allows a monster to feel the vibrations through a solid surface caused by movement. It is an imprecise sense with a limited range (listed in the ability). Tremorsense functions only if the monster is on the same surface as the subject, and only if the subject is moving along (or burrowing through) the surface.

abilities.name: Earthbound
abilities.desc: When not touching solid ground, the living landslide is Slowed 1 and can't use reactions.

abilities.name: Crumble
abilities.desc:
Trigger The living landslide takes damage from a hostile source while atop rock or earth

Effect The living landslide crumbles into the ground, Burrowing down 10 feet. This Burrowing does not trigger reactions.

The living landslide can't Crumble again for 1d4 rounds.

abilities.name: Earth Glide
abilities.desc: The living landslide can Burrow through any earthen matter, including rock. When it does so, the living landslide moves at its full burrow Speed, leaving no tunnels or signs of its passing.

abilities.name: Sliding Earth
abilities.desc: The living landslide Strides up to twice its normal Speed in a straight line, then attempts to Trip a creature in its reach. If a creature falls Prone from this Trip, it takes 1d4 bludgeoning damage for every 10 feet the living landslide moved.

denizen-of-leng.name: Denizen of Leng
denizen-of-leng.blurb: Travelers and raiders from the cold, windswept dimension of Leng, these malevolent human-shaped creatures range across reality in ominous black ships capable of sailing beyond the borders of dimensions and planes. Although most denizens of Leng seek conquest and riches, others operate as self-styled ambassadors and merchants, sowing discord with far-ranging plots. While the inscrutable denizens dress themselves in flowing robes, veils, and broad turbans to appear human, their aberrant physiology, when glimpsed, is evident from their crown of stubby horns and tentacled jaws to their furry, goat-like legs.

abilities.name: Constant Spells
abilities.desc: A constant spell affects the monster without the monster needing to cast it, and its duration is unlimited. If a constant spell gets counteracted, the monster can reactivate it by spending the normal spellcasting actions the spell requires.

abilities.name: Planar Fast Healing
abilities.desc:
A denizen of Leng maintains a connection to Leng at all times, and when away from Leng, they have fast healing 5. They lose this ability on Leng or in areas where planar connections do not function. If killed, their body dissolves into nothingness in 1d4 rounds, leaving behind their equipment. A slain denizen reforms in Leng; they can be permanently killed only when their planar fast healing doesn't function.

A monster with this ability regains the given number of Hit Points each round at the beginning of its turn.

abilities.name: No Breath
abilities.desc: Denizens of Leng don't need to breathe.

abilities.name: Debilitating Bite
abilities.desc: A creature that takes damage from a denizen's bite must succeed at a DC 27 Fortitude save or become Clumsy 1. Each time a target fails an additional save against this ability, the condition value increases by 1 (to a maximum of Clumsy 4). This condition value decreases by 1 every 24 hours.

abilities.name: Leng Ruby
abilities.desc: Many denizens of Leng carry strange rubies mined from quarries in Leng. As long as a creature holds a Leng ruby that it willingly accepted as a gift or payment from a denizen of Leng, any denizen of Leng can target that creature with Mind Reading, Outcast's Curse, or Phantom Pain at a range of 1 mile, and the bearer uses an outcome one degree of success worse than the result of its saving throw against outcast's curse.

shade-plane-of-metal.name: Shade (Plane of Metal)
shade-plane-of-metal.blurb: Metal pneuma appear as versions of their mortal selves made of various, often sharpened, metals.

abilities.name: Planar Incarnation - Plane of Metal (Metal Pneuma)
abilities.desc:
All shades are formed from and personify the nature of the plane on which they manifest, and their statistics are adjusted as summarized below. They also gain any trait associated with creatures from their plane.

Plane of Metal (Metal Pneuma) Metal pneuma appear as versions of their mortal selves made of various, often sharpened, metals.

  • Language Talican
  • Additional Ability resistance 3 to electricity
  • Melee claw +7 (metal, versatile P), Damage 1d8+2 slashing

bleachling-survivor.name: Bleachling Survivor
bleachling-survivor.blurb: It is almost unheard of for gnomes to survive the horrendous sickness known as the Bleaching, but those few who do are permanently altered. Having lived through the worst disease known to their kind, bleachling survivors often emerge jaded and reckless, traveling to seek out mind-bending experiences and heady thrills that will awaken something in them again. Though their experiences may toughen them, they are not unfriendly. Most try to help others they meet during their travels who might not be as unshakable.

abilities.name: Unflappable
abilities.desc: When the bleachling survivor rolls a critical failure on a check with the emotion trait, they get a failure instead.

abilities.name: Flinch Back
abilities.desc:
Trigger An enemy moves into an adjacent space

Effect The bleachling survivor Steps up to 10 feet. They must end this movement in a space that is not adjacent to an enemy.

abilities.name: Sneak Attack
abilities.desc: The bleachling survivor deals an extra 1d6 precision damage to Off-Guard creatures.

venom-mage.name: Venom Mage
venom-mage.src: Pathfinder #160: Assault on Hunting Lodge Seven

abilities.name: Venom Explosion
abilities.desc:
Trigger The venom mage is reduced to 0 Hit Points

Effect The venom mage explodes into a cloud of poison within a 20-foot burst. The venom mage then reforms at a point they choose within the burst, avoids being knocked out, and remains at 1 Hit Point. The venom mage's Wounded value increases by 1 when they use this ability, and they can't use this ability when they're wounded 3 or more. Creatures other than the venom mage within the burst must attempt a DC 25 Fortitude save.

Critical Success No effect.

Success The creature is Sickened 1.

Failure The creature is Sickened 2 and cannot recover from the sickened condition while within 20 feet of the venom mage.

Critical Failure As failure, but Sickened 4.

Note: A DC was not provided for this ability by Paizo. The DC present here is a moderate DC for the creature level according to the Gamemastery Guide creature building Tables.

abilities.name: Steady Spellcasting
abilities.desc: If another creature's reaction would disrupt the venom mage's spellcasting action, the venom mage attempts a DC 15 flat check. If the venom mage succeeds, their action isn't disrupted.

honor-guard.name: Honor Guard
honor-guard.blurb: Desert giants are nomadic humanoids who have dwelled in the world's most arid regions since time immemorial. Smaller peoples know that desert giants are the undisputed masters of desert living, and ignorant humans often claim that it is a desert giant's unique physiology, like a camel, that enables them to survive without water for 2 weeks. The few desert giants who mingle in the societies of smaller humanoids don't bother to dispute such ridiculous rumors.

abilities.name: Catch Rock
abilities.desc:
Requirements The monster must have a free hand but can Release anything it's holding as part of this reaction.

Trigger The monster is targeted with a thrown rock Strike or a rock would fall on the monster.

Effect The monster gains a +4 circumstance bonus to its AC against the triggering attack or to any defense against the falling rock. If the attack misses or the monster successfully defends against the falling rock, the monster catches the rock, takes no damage, and is now holding the rock.

abilities.name: Sand Spin
abilities.desc:
Requirements The desert giant is standing in sandy terrain

Effect The desert giant spins around and stirs up loose sand in a 10-foot emanation. Until the beginning of the giant's next turn, creatures in the area are Concealed, and other creatures are concealed to them.

abilities.name: Sandwalking
abilities.desc: Desert giants have adapted to the loose sands of the desert and can move across them with ease. Desert giants ignore non-magical difficult terrain and uneven ground caused by sand.

abilities.name: Scimitar Blitz
abilities.desc: The desert giant Strides up to their Speed, Striking once with each of their scimitars at any point during the movement.

abilities.name: Throw Rock
abilities.desc: The monster picks up a rock within reach or retrieves a stowed rock and throws it, making a ranged Strike.

oriole.name: Oriole
oriole.saveNote: +1 vs. effects granting the controlled condition

abilities.name: +1 Vs. Effects Granting the Controlled Condition
Ganzi Resistance
abilities.desc: At the beginning of each day, the element Oriole resists is randomly determined by rolling 1d6 (1–2 acid, 3–4 electricity, and 5–6 sonic), but this resistance can change during the day as they Alter Resistance.

abilities.name: Alter Resistance
abilities.desc:
Frequency once per hour

Trigger Oriole takes acid, electricity, or sonic damage

Effect Oriole's energy resistance changes to match the triggering damage and immediately applies to the damage.

abilities.name: Blood Magic
abilities.desc: When Oriole casts Animal Vision, Calm, Charm, Repulsion, Unfettered Pack, Vital Beacon, Wave of Despair, or any of their bloodline spells, their movements are so graceful that they distract foes. This either grants Oriole a +1 status bonus to Diplomacy checks for 1 round or imposes a –1 status penalty on one target's Will saves for 1 round.

abilities.name: Crossblooded Evolution
abilities.desc: While Oriole's sorcerous bloodline comes from a mysterious connection to nymphs in their ancestry, their equally mysterious ancestral connection to proteans influences their spell repertoire such that they can cast Illusory Disguise as well. They can heighten illusory disguise freely.

abilities.name: Legendary Diva
abilities.desc:
Frequency once per day

Trigger Oriole succeeds at a Performance check to act, dance, or sing

Effect Oriole critically succeeds at the check instead.

abilities.name: Many Forms
abilities.desc: Oriole can freely heighten any spell with the polymorph trait.

abilities.name: Skinsaw Eye
abilities.desc: Norgorber granted Delaraius an eye to aid him in his quest for vengeance, but this eye also significantly enhances the priest. It grants him darkvision and Truesight as a constant innate spell, and also increases all of his attribute modifiers by 4. He is immune to bleed damage, magical detection and mental communication (unless he chooses otherwise), and magical alteration of his memories unless he chooses to be affected or the effect comes from a deity or artifact. The Skinsaw Eye serves as a religious symbol for Delaraius. If he ever loses the Skinsaw Eye, Delaraius loses all of these benefits and becomes Drained 3.

abilities.name: Vulnerable to Sunlight
abilities.desc: Delaraius takes 50 untyped damage for every hour he's exposed to sunlight.

abilities.name: King of Keys
abilities.desc: Delaraius's magic is more powerful when he's located in Vyre or Duskfathom. The counteract DC for all of his spells increases by 2 as long as the spell effect is located in either of these locations, and Delaraius gains a +2 status bonus on counteract checks while in either location.

abilities.name: Skinsaw Strike
abilities.desc: Delaraius focuses his attention on a target he can see, causing his Skinsaw Eye to glow red for a moment as he seeks out the most painful place to attack that target. He then attempts a Medicine check against the target's Fortitude DC; on a success, that target is Off-Guard to Delaraius until the end of his turn. On a critical success, that target is off-guard to Delaraius until the end of his next turn.

abilities.name: Sneak Attack
abilities.desc: Delaraius deals 3d6 extra precision damage to creatures who are Off-Guard.

escorite.name: Escorite
escorite.blurb: The winged silhouette of a descending escorite makes for a terrifying yet beautiful sight that precedes a gruesome end. This enormous fey moth has a wingspan as wide as 15 feet. Equally intimidating are their fleshless horned skull and eerie tendrils that hang from their abdomen.

abilities.name: Telepathy (100 feet)
abilities.desc: A monster with telepathy can communicate mentally with any creatures within the listed radius, as long as they share a language. This doesn't give any special access to their thoughts, and communicates no more information than normal speech would.

abilities.name: +1 Status to All Saves vs. Magic
Aura of Inevitability
abilities.desc: 30 feet. The escorite exudes an aura that reinforces the inevitability of nonexistence. Any creature that enters or begins their turn in the aura must attempt a DC 24 Will save or become Frightened 2 (Frightened 3 on a critical failure). On a successful save, a creature is temporarily immune to the escorite's aura for 24 hours.

abilities.name: Deteriorating Flight
abilities.desc:
Frequency once per round

Effect The escorite Flies, shedding dust from their wings, and can move through the spaces of any creatures in their path. Each creature whose space they move through takes 3d6 void damage (basic DC 26 Reflex save). On a failure, an invisible creature also becomes Concealed instead for 1 round.

abilities.name: Entropic Flurry
abilities.desc: The escorite makes up to four tentacle Strikes, each against a different target within reach. The void damage from these Strikes is persistent void damage instead. Each attack counts toward their multiple attack penalty, but the penalty doesn't increase until after the escorite makes all their attacks.

abilities.name: Hollow Eyes
abilities.desc:
The escorite focuses the forces of entropy upon a creature they can see within 60 feet. The creature takes 8d6 void damage and must attempt a DC 26 Fortitude save.

Critical Success The creature takes no damage.

Success The creature takes half damage and is Enfeebled 1 for 1 round.

Failure The creature takes full damage and is Enfeebled 2 for 1 round. A creature reduced to 0 HP by this damage immediately turns to dust, including all items it's currently carrying; the creature can be restored only via a Wish ritual or similarly powerful effect.

Critical Failure As failure, but the creature takes double damage and is enfeebled 2 for 1 minute.

elder-cauthooj.name: Elder Cauthooj
elder-cauthooj.blurb: These large, flightless birds are deceptively agile, considering their long bodies and awkward, hopping gait. Solitary predators, they use their hypnotic warbling song to drive prey into a wild frenzy, manipulating them into attacking one another so that the cauthooj can then feast on the remains.

abilities.name: Thoughtsense (Imprecise) 60 feet
abilities.desc: The cauthooj senses a creatures mental essence at the listed ranged.

abilities.name: Hop-Dodge
abilities.desc:
Trigger The cauthooj is the target of a melee Strike and is adjacent to another enemy that is also within the reach of the melee Strike.

Effect The cauthooj nimbly hops aside, redirecting the triggering Strike against the adjacent enemy. The cauthooj Strides up to half its Speed, and this movement does not trigger reactions.

abilities.name: Staccato Strike
abilities.desc: With subtle alterations in the pitch and tone of its song, the cauthooj directs one creature Confused by its Warbling Song to make a Strike. This works like other Strikes made by confused creatures, except that the cauthooj chooses the target. If no target is in reach or range, or the creature is unable to Strike for any other reason, this ability has no effect.

abilities.name: Warbling Song
abilities.desc:
The cauthooj gives a strange, ululating cry that causes nearby creatures to lash out violently and without control. Each creature within 120-foot emanation that can hear the cauthooj must attempt a DC 34 Will save to resist the effect.

Critical Success The target is unaffected and is temporarily immune for 1 minute.

Success The target is unaffected.

Failure The target is Confused for 1 round.

Critical Failure The target is Confused for 1 round and immediately attacks itself (in the normal fashion for attacking oneself while confused). This Strike doesn't give the creature a flat check to recover from the confusion.

brine-dragon-young-spellcaster.name: Brine Dragon (Young, Spellcaster)
brine-dragon-young-spellcaster.perceptionNote: (+18 to Sense Motive); aquatic echolocation 120 feet
brine-dragon-young-spellcaster.saveNote: +2 status to all saves vs. primal

abilities.name: Aquatic Echolocation
abilities.desc: A brine dragon can use their hearing as a precise sense at the listed range, but only underwater.

abilities.name: +2 Status to All Saves Vs. Primal
Regent's Glower
abilities.desc:
Trigger The dragon is critically hit with a melee attack

Effect The dragon focuses their weighty gaze upon their assailant, filling their foe with dread. The triggering creature takes 4d6 mental damage with a basic DC 26 Will save. Any creature who fails the save also becomes Frightened 1 (Frightened 2 on a critical failure).

abilities.name: Benthic Bite
abilities.desc: A creature who takes damage from a brine dragon's jaws Strike must succeed at a DC 26 Fortitude save or be Enfeebled 1 for 1 round.

abilities.name: Crushing Breath
abilities.desc: The dragon spews a 50-foot line of pressurized water that deals 8d6 bludgeoning damage with a basic DC 26 Reflex save. A creature that fails the save is also Clumsy 1 (Clumsy 2 on a critical failure) for 1 minute. The dragon can't use Crushing Breath again for 1d4 rounds.

abilities.name: Pressurized Pool
abilities.desc: The dragon expels a 10-foot burst of pressurized water within 120 feet that lasts for 1 minute. A creature other than a brine dragon that enters or begins their turn within a burst must succeed at a DC 26 Fortitude save or become Encumbered until the beginning of their next turn.

charau-ka-acolyte-of-angazhan.name: Charau-ka Acolyte of Angazhan
charau-ka-acolyte-of-angazhan.src: Pathfinder Lost Omens The Mwangi Expanse
charau-ka-acolyte-of-angazhan.blurb: Even with the Gorilla King's fall, many charau-ka still worship the terrible might of the god Angazhan. The strongest of these acolytes guard the steps of the High Throne in Usaro, ensuring that no one without Angazhan's favor or suitable physical prowess can approach the top of the massive stone step pyramid.

abilities.name: Shrieking Frenzy
abilities.desc:
Trigger The charau-ka's turn begins.

Frequency once per hour

Effect The charau-ka is Quickened until the end of its turn, and can use the extra action to Stride or Strike.

While in the frenzy, the charau-ka can't speak and automatically critically fails Stealth checks, due to its loud wailing.

abilities.name: Thrown Weapon Mastery
abilities.desc:
Any weapon a charau-ka throws gains the deadly d6 weapon trait.

Furthermore, when a charau-ka throws an improvised weapon, it does not take the -2 penalty for doing so, nor does it take a penalty for using a thrown improvised weapon with the nonlethal trait to make a lethal attack.

yeast-ooze.name: Yeast Ooze
yeast-ooze.src: Pathfinder #178: Punks in a Powder Keg
yeast-ooze.blurb: Urban pollution breeds all kinds of new and interesting ooze creatures.

abilities.name: Motion Sense 60 feet
abilities.desc: A yeast ooze can sense nearby creatures through vibration and air or water movement.

abilities.name: Monstrous Yeast
abilities.desc:
Whenever a creature infected with monstrous yeast takes cold damage, they can make a new saving throw with a +2 circumstance bonus. Failure doesn't advance the disease

Saving Throw DC 16 Fortitude save

Onset 1 round

Stage 1 Off-Guard (1 hour)

Stage 2 Enfeebled 1 and off-guard (1 hour)

Stage 3 Enfeebled 2 and off-guard (1 day)

mutated-trollhound.name: Mutated Trollhound
mutated-trollhound.blurb: Trollhounds are squat, slavering beasts akin to trolls in canine form. Requiring vast quantities of meat to fuel their regenerative metabolisms, packs of wild trollhounds prowl the foothills of regions where trolls dwell, their voracious hunger driving them to slaughter and consume any prey they encounter. In some regions, trolls breed trollhounds as pets, utilizing the trollhounds' keen sense of smell to aid in the hunt.

abilities.name: Regeneration 15 (Deactivated by Acid or Fire)
abilities.desc: This monster regains the listed number of Hit Points each round at the beginning of its turn. Its Dying condition never increases beyond Dying 3 as long as its regeneration is active. However, if it takes damage of a type listed in the regeneration entry, its regeneration deactivates until the end of its next turn. Deactivate the regeneration before applying any damage of a listed type, since that damage might kill the monster by bringing it to Dying 4.

abilities.name: Bloodfire Fever
abilities.desc:
Saving Throw DC 20 Fortitude save

Stage 1 carrier with no ill effect (1 day)

Stage 2 Enfeebled 1 (1 day)

Stage 3 Enfeebled 1 and Clumsy 1 (1 day)

Stage 4 Enfeebled 2 and Clumsy 2 (1 day)

Stage 5 Enfeebled 2, Clumsy 2, and Fatigued (1 day)

abilities.name: Pack Attack
abilities.desc: The trollhound deals an extra 1d6 damage to any creature within reach of at least two of the trollhound's allies.

abilities.name: Knockdown
abilities.desc:
Requirements The monster's last action was a successful Strike that lists Knockdown in its damage entry

Effect The monster attempts to Trip the creature. This attempt neither applies nor counts toward the monster's multiple attack penalty.

commoner-pfs-2-13.name: Commoner (PFS 2-13)
commoner-pfs-2-13.src: Pathfinder Society Scenario #2-13: A Gilded Test
commoner-pfs-2-13.blurb: Though not every commoner is downtrodden, many live hard lives of toil as they work to keep their families fed and housed in relative comfort. While many commoners are just simple folks who keep to themselves, sometimes commoners rebel, either rising up to face their oppressors or persuaded or even duped into joining nefarious plans and criminal conspiracies. Commoners benefit from power in numbers, and a crowd of commoners can accomplish a great deal more than their rulers often expect.

abilities.name: Power of the Mob
abilities.desc: When three or more commoners are adjacent to each other each commoner gets a +1 circumstance bonus to Athletics checks to Shove, attack rolls, and damage rolls.

eltha-embercall-9-10.name: Eltha Embercall (9-10)
eltha-embercall-9-10.src: Pathfinder Society Scenario #3-15: Cavern of Sundered Songs

abilities.name: Steadying Stone
abilities.desc: If Eltha rolls a success on an Acrobatics check to Balance on uneven ground composed of earth or rock, she gets a critical success instead. As long as she remains on the ground, she has a +3 circumstance bonus to her Fortitude or Reflex DC against attempts to Shove or Trip her. This bonus also applies to saving throws against spells or effects that would attempt to knock her prone.

sewer-gator.name: Sewer Gator
sewer-gator.src: Pathfinder Society Scenario #5-20: The Rakshasa's Court

abilities.name: Wall Slam
abilities.desc:
Requirements The sewer gator must have a creature Grabbed

Effect The sewer gator flips its body, twisting its victim, then releases, flinging them into the nearest wall. It makes a jaws Strike with a +2 circumstance bonus to the attack roll against the grabbed creature. If it hits, it also does 2d4+7 bludgeoning damage and knocks the creature Prone. If it fails, it releases the creature.

abilities.name: Grab
abilities.desc:
Requirements The monster's last action was a successful Strike that lists Grab in its damage entry, or the monster has a creature Grabbed or Restrained

Effect If used after a Strike, the monster attempts to Grapple the creature using the body part it attacked with. This attempt neither applies nor counts toward the creature's multiple attack penalty.

The monster can instead use Grab and choose one creature it's grabbing or restraining with an appendage that has Grab to automatically extend that condition to the end of the monster's next turn.

weak-giant-er-mouse.name: Weak Giant-er Mouse
weak-giant-er-mouse.src: Pathfinder Society Quest #16: The Winter Queen's Dollhouse

abilities.name: Skittish
abilities.desc:
Trigger The giant-er mouse is hit with a melee attack

Effect The giant-er mouse takes a step after the effects of the triggering attack are resolved.

abilities.name: Grab
abilities.desc:
Requirements The monster's last action was a successful Strike that lists Grab in its damage entry, or the monster has a creature Grabbed or Restrained

Effect If used after a Strike, the monster attempts to Grapple the creature using the body part it attacked with. This attempt neither applies nor counts toward the creature's multiple attack penalty.

The monster can instead use Grab and choose one creature it's grabbing or restraining with an appendage that has Grab to automatically extend that condition to the end of the monster's next turn.

abilities.name: Always Ready for a Scufe
abilities.desc:
Trigger A creature gets in melee range of the ogre hunter

Effect The ogre hunter draws a melee weapon.

abilities.name: Reactive Strike
abilities.desc:
Trigger A creature within the monster's reach uses a manipulate action or a move action, makes a ranged attack, or leaves a square during a move action it's using.

Effect The monster attempts a melee Strike against the triggering creature. If the attack is a critical hit and the trigger was a manipulate action, the monster disrupts that action. This Strike doesn't count toward the monster's multiple attack penalty, and its multiple attack penalty doesn't apply to this Strike.

abilities.name: Hunting Throw
abilities.desc: The ogre hunter makes a ranged strike with their trident within 60 feet without ranged penalties. If the strike hits, it has enough force to knock the target Prone. If the strike was a critical success, the target is also Immobilized by the trident.

corrupted-elder-tree.name: Corrupted Elder Tree
corrupted-elder-tree.blurb: Arboreal regents-also called treants-are lumbering, solitary creatures responsible for guarding an entire forest. They take an especially long view of affairs and never act brashly or without much deliberation. They occasionally come together in small groups called groves to share news and pass their wisdom down to the arboreal wardens that have sprouted under their watch. In times of grave danger, all the groves in a region may gather for a great months-long meeting to plan and, eventually, act upon a threat.

abilities.name: Constant Spells
abilities.desc: A constant spell affects the monster without the monster needing to cast it, and its duration is unlimited. If a constant spell gets counteracted, the monster can reactivate it by spending the normal spellcasting actions the spell requires.

abilities.name: Axe Vulnerability
abilities.desc: The arboreal regent takes 5 additional damage from axes.

abilities.name: Awaken Tree
abilities.desc: The arboreal regent causes a tree within 180 feet to uproot itself and fight as a minion using the statistics for an Awakened Tree. The arboreal regent can control up to two awakened trees at a time, and it can issue commands to both trees as a single action, which has the concentrate and auditory traits.

abilities.name: Sunder Objects
abilities.desc: When an arboreal regent damages an item or structure, it deals an additional 2d10 damage to that item or structure.

abilities.name: Throw Rock
abilities.desc: The monster picks up a rock within reach or retrieves a stowed rock and throws it, making a ranged Strike.

fazil.name: Fazil
fazil.blurb: Most kobolds encountered outside of a well-defended warren or lair are kobold scouts, creatures trained for stalking and the hunt.

abilities.name: Hurried Retreat
abilities.desc:
Requirements The kobold scout is adjacent to at least one enemy.

Effect The kobold scout Strides up to its Speed plus 5 feet and gains a +2 circumstance bonus to AC against reactions triggered by this movement. It must end this movement in a space that's not adjacent to any enemy.

abilities.name: Sneak Attack
abilities.desc: The kobold scout deals an extra 1d6 precision damage to Off-Guard creatures.

abilities.name: Stench
abilities.desc:
10 feet. DC 17 Fortitude save

A creature entering the aura or starting its turn in the area must succeed at a Fortitude save or become Sickened 1 (plus Slowed 1 as long as it's sickened on a critical failure). A creature that succeeds at its save or recovers from being sickened is temporarily immune to all stench auras for 1 minute.

abilities.name: Void Healing
abilities.desc: A creature with void healing draws health from void energy rather than vitality energy. It is damaged by vitality damage and is not healed by vitality healing effects. It does not take void damage, and it is healed by void effects that heal undead.

abilities.name: Consume Flesh
abilities.desc:
Requirements The ghoul is adjacent to the corpse of a creature that died within the last hour.

Effect The ghoul devours a chunk of the corpse and regains 1+max0,floorlevel/2d6 healing Hit Points.

It can regain Hit Points from any given corpse only once.

abilities.name: Ghoul Whispers
abilities.desc:
Requirements A Grabbed, Paralyzed, Restrained, or Unconscious creature is within the ghoul's reach

Effect The ghoul whispers dark thoughts and vile cravings into the creature's ears. The creature must save against the forbidden cravings curse.

Forbidden Cravings (curse) A creature can still eat and drink while sickened by this curse

Saving Throw DC 20 Will save, using the high spell DC for the ghoul's level

Stage 1 carrier with no ill effects (1 day)

Stage 2 2d6 void damage and the target is Sickened 1 until it consumes raw meat (1 day)

Stage 3 as stage 2

Stage 4 as stage 2 unless the target has consumed raw meat in the past 24 hours, then it takes 4d6 void damage and is Sickened 2 until it consumes raw meat;

Stage 5 if the creature has eaten raw meat in the past 24 hours, it dies and rises as a ghoul, if not, it returns to stage 4

abilities.name: Grave Knowledge
abilities.desc:
Frequency once per hour

Effect The ghoul calls upon knowledge it retains from one creature it has consumed in the past 7 days. The ghoul attempts a skill check using a skill in which the consumed creature was trained (if it's unclear whether the creature was trained, the GM decides). The ghoul is treated as trained and uses the high skill modifier for the ghoul's level (1d20+10). This takes the same amount of actions or time as usual for the check.

The ghoul can instead automatically learn something specific known by a creature it consumed in the last 7 days, like the location of a hidden treasure or the name of a loved one. The ghoul can do this only once for a given creature, no matter how much of its flesh the ghoul consumed.

abilities.name: Sneak Attack
abilities.desc: Carexilia deals an additional 1d6 precision damage to Off-Guard creatures.

abilities.name: Swift Leap
abilities.desc: The ghoul jumps up to half its Speed. This movement doesn't trigger reactions.

abilities.name: Grab
abilities.desc:
Requirements The monster's last action was a successful Strike that lists Grab in its damage entry, or the monster has a creature Grabbed or Restrained

Effect If used after a Strike, the monster attempts to Grapple the creature using the body part it attacked with. This attempt neither applies nor counts toward the creature's multiple attack penalty.

The monster can instead use Grab and choose one creature it's grabbing or restraining with an appendage that has Grab to automatically extend that condition to the end of the monster's next turn.

thash.name: Thash
thash.blurb: Thashes are elementals that escaped the Plane of Earth millennia ago and now wander the wilds of Sekamina. Resembling ankylosauruses with two tails—one at its back end, and one where its head should be—thashes have no traditional sensory organs. Rather, they experience the world solely through the vibrations they sense in the ground beneath their feet.

abilities.name: Footstep Follower
abilities.desc:
Trigger A creature the thash can sense with its tremorsense finishes a Stride within 60 feet.

Effect The thash Strides toward the creature.

abilities.name: Prone Difficulty
abilities.desc: The thash takes a –2 circumstance penalty to its Reflex DC against Trip attempts. While Prone, the thash is upside down and Immobilized. The thash must succeed at a DC 30 Athletics check to Stand.

abilities.name: Reactive Strike (Special)
abilities.desc:
The thash gains an additional reaction at the beginning of each of its turns, which it can use only for Reactive Strikes.

Trigger A creature within the monster's reach uses a manipulate action or a move action, makes a ranged attack, or leaves a square during a move action it's using.

Effect The monster attempts a melee Strike against the triggering creature. If the attack is a critical hit and the trigger was a manipulate action, the monster disrupts that action. This Strike doesn't count toward the monster's multiple attack penalty, and its multiple attack penalty doesn't apply to this Strike.

abilities.name: Soft Underbelly
abilities.desc: The thash has an AC of 24 against attacks made directly below it or directly above it while the thash is Prone.

abilities.name: Splintery Shell
abilities.desc: The thash has Hardness 10 against damage from sources directly above it. When the thash takes bludgeoning damage from a source directly above it, jagged splinters fly from its shell in a 5-foot emanation. Creatures in the area except the thash take 2d8 piercing damage (basic DC 27 Reflex save).

abilities.name: Vertical Blind Spot
abilities.desc: A thash can't attack a target directly above it, including creatures riding on its back.

abilities.name: Double Tail
abilities.desc: The thash makes two tail Strikes against different targets. These Strikes count as one attack for the thash's multiple attack penalty, and the penalty doesn't increase until after it has made both attacks. The thash is then Immobilized until the beginning of its next turn.

abilities.name: Punishing Tail
abilities.desc: A creature struck by the thash's tail Strike must attempt at a DC 27 Fortitude save. On a failure, they're Stunned 1 (or Stunned 3 on a critical failure).

abilities.name: Final Words
abilities.desc: When Azotixo dies, he explodes in a burst of psychic energy. All creatures in a 10-foot emanation take 12d6 mental damage (basic DC 27 Will save). His possessions are left in a pile where he died.

abilities.name: Leave in the Dark
abilities.desc:
Trigger A creature attempts to Recall Knowledge about Azotixo and fails

Effect Failing to properly recognize the caligni archivist creates a mental feedback loop. If the triggering check was a failure, the creature is Off-Guard for 1 round. On a critical failure, the creature becomes Confused for 1 round instead.

abilities.name: Recognize Opportunity
abilities.desc: Azotixo deals 1d6 extra precision damage to frightened or Off-Guard creatures.

abilities.name: Rewrite Records
abilities.desc:
Azotixo attempts to scramble the memories of a creature within 30 feet, filling their mind with terrifying images. The creature attempts a DC 30 Will save.

Critical Success The creature is unaffected and becomes temporarily immune to Rewrite Records for 1 day.

Success The creature takes 4d6 mental damage.

Failure The creature takes 8d6 mental damage and is Frightened 1.

Critical Failure As failure, but the creature is Frightened 2.

agyra.name: Agyra
agyra.blurb: Agyra is a massive kaiju who protects Spinescar Island and its inhabitants.

abilities.name: Remove a Condition
abilities.desc:
Cost 1 Mythic Point

Effect Agyra removes any one condition currently affecting her.

abilities.name: Stormsight
abilities.desc: Wind, precipitation, and clouds don't impair Agyra's vision; she ignores the Concealed condition from storms, mist, precipitation, and the like.

abilities.name: Regeneration
abilities.desc: This monster regains the listed number of Hit Points each round at the beginning of its turn. Its Dying condition never increases beyond Dying 3 as long as its regeneration is active. However, if it takes damage of a type listed in the regeneration entry, its regeneration deactivates until the end of its next turn. Deactivate the regeneration before applying any damage of a listed type, since that damage might kill the monster by bringing it to Dying 4.

abilities.name: Electrified Rebirth
abilities.desc:
Frequency once per year

Effect When Agyra dies, her corpse crackles and sparks with electrical energy. Any creature that touches Agyra's body within 1 hour of her death takes 11d6 electricity damage (basic DC 43 Reflex save). After being dead for 1 minute, Agyra is immediately resurrected in the same place, at full health, with all abilities fully restored. She normally takes advantage of this rebirth to flee to safety, using Thunderous Departure to retreat. If Agyra has already died and been reborn in the same year, she remains permanently dead upon being slain a second time.

abilities.name: Mythic Immunity
abilities.desc:
Strikes

The creature is immune to either harmful spells cast by non-mythic creatures, or Strikes made with non-mythic weapons and unarmed Strikes from non-mythic characters. Only the most powerful creatures (typically level 25) should be immune to both.

abilities.name: Mythic Resilience
abilities.desc: Agyra treats her saving throws with Fortitude and Reflex saves as one step better than they actually are (so a critical failure is a failure, a failure is a success, and a success is a critical success). Whenever a character rolls a critical hit against Agyra, they must reroll the attack roll and take the new result.

abilities.name: Blinding Flash
abilities.desc:
Cost 1 Mythic Point

Effect By spreading her wings while she stands upon the ground, Agyra can create a blinding flash of light that targets all creatures within 100 feet. Affected creatures must succeed at a DC 43 Fortitude check.

Critical Success The target is unaffected.

Success The target is Dazzled and Stupefied 1 for 1d4 rounds.

Failure The target is Blinded and Stupefied 2 for 1 minute.

Critical Failure The target is blinded and stupefied 2 for 10 minutes.

abilities.name: Conjure Hurricane
abilities.desc:
Frequency once per day

Cost 1 Mythic Point

Effect Agyra generates a hurricane that spreads across a 4-mile radius and lasts 24 hours, with a 500-foot calm eye of the storm at its center. Agyra is at the center of this hurricane when it is formed, but it moves normally (according to surrounding weather conditions and the GM's discretion) afterward.

abilities.name: Lightning Breath
abilities.desc: Agyra exhales a line of electricity from each of her two heads. Each line is 120 feet long and 10 feet wide, and the two lines may be pointed in different directions. A creature in a line takes 22d6 electricity damage (basic DC 44 Reflex save). On a failed save, the target is also Slowed 1 for 1d4 rounds. A creature can be affected only once by a line, even if they are in an overlapping area. A character slain by Agyra's Lightning Breath remains electrified for 2d4 rounds after death. A creature touching such a corpse takes 3d6 electricity damage (no save). Agyra can't use Lightning Breath for 1d4 rounds.

abilities.name: Mythic Power
abilities.desc: The creature has a pool of 3 Mythic Points, and can spend those Mythic Points for any of the actions it has.

abilities.name: Recharge Ability
abilities.desc:
Cost 1 Mythic Point

Effect Agyra gains an additional use of lightning breath.

abilities.name: Stormflight
abilities.desc: Agyra can move in strong winds with ease. She doesn't treat wind as difficult terrain or need to Maneuver in Flight in high winds.

abilities.name: Thunderous Departure
abilities.desc:
Frequency once per day

Effect Agyra Flies in a straight line at incredible speed, moving at least 120 feet but up to 1 mile. This movement doesn't provoke reactions. Her departure leaves behind a thunderous sonic boom, creating a 100-foot burst centered on her point of departure. All creatures in the area take 15d10 sonic damage (basic DC 46 Fortitude save). A creature who fails is also knocked Prone, and a creature who critically fails is knocked prone and Deafened permanently.
